messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

The function signature expects companies: string[], duration: string. But we need to provide separate calls for each duration? The user says "for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon and Tesla respectively in 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks and 1 month". That implies mapping: Apple -> 1 week, Microsoft -> 2 weeks, Amazon -> 3 weeks, Tesla -> 1 month. So we need to call get_stock_prices with companies ["Apple"] duration "1 week", then ["Microsoft"] duration "2 weeks", etc. Or we could combine?
